summary: Four weeks. Spend them on the two things that do not transfer by documentation: the override judgment and the operator relationship.

actions.action: Learner leads both condition reviews; expert observes only.
actions.why_now: Independence needs more than one demonstration to be credible.

actions.action: Introduce the local contact on the operator call.
actions.why_now: A relationship needs two contacts before it holds on its own.

actions.action: Learner raises the load transfer request unaided.
actions.why_now: Last window before departure where a transfer is actually due.

actions.action: Document the override heuristic and review it with the team.
actions.why_now: The only artefact that outlives the handover.

risks.title: Operator relationship does not transfer
risks.what_stops_working: Contested windows stop being negotiable locally.
risks.mitigation: Two joint calls, then one handed over entirely.

risks.title: Override judgment stays thinly evidenced
risks.what_stops_working: Scheduling reverts to the calendar rule under pressure.
risks.mitigation: Two unobserved reviews plus a written heuristic.

still_expert_dependent_at_departure: Independent window negotiation with the regional operator.
